list_files.description: The loan data files SBA currently publishes (from data.sba.gov's catalog): 7(a) and 504 FOIA loan-level CSVs (file names carry the as-of date), activity reports, disaster loan workbooks. One row per file with the path for the foia request.

search.desc: keep files whose dataset or file title contains this (e.g. FOIA, 504, Disaster)

foia.description: SBA 7(a) or 504 loan-level FOIA data: one row per approved loan with borrower, lender (or CDC), amount, approval date and fiscal year, NAICS industry, project state and county, congressional district, loan status, charge-off. Read streaming and filtered: give at least one of state, fiscal_year, from, naics.

file.desc: the file's path under /sites/default/files without .csv, from list_files, e.g. uploaded_resources/FOIA_504_FY2010_Present_asof_260930

state.desc: keep loans with this ProjectState (two letters; a list works)

fiscal_year.desc: keep these ApprovalFY values (a year or a list)

naics.desc: keep NaicsCode values starting with these digits (e.g. 72; a list works)
